The evidence suggests that Vatalbinoside C may act as a modulator of CDK3/cyclin E activity, potentially influencing cell cycle progression and tumor growth in CCRF-HSB-2 cells. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible mechanism by which Vatalbinoside C could exert its effects on CCRF-HSB-2, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated. The observed scores and the direct targeting of CDK3/cyclin E to CCRF-HSB-2 indicate a plausible but not yet fully understood relationship, emphasizing the need for further experimental validation.
